diCards.warRage.name: War Rage
diCards.warRage.text: In Battle: your Troop gains +1 Strength.
diCards.warFury.name: War Fury
diCards.warFury.text: In Battle: your Troop gains +2 Strength.
diCards.bloodyBattle.name: Bloody Battle
diCards.bloodyBattle.text: In Battle: your Troop gains +1 Damage.
diCards.bloodbath.name: Bloodbath
diCards.bloodbath.text: In Battle: your Troop gains +2 Damage.
diCards.bronzeWall.name: Bronze Wall
diCards.bronzeWall.text: In Battle: your Troop gains +1 Defense.
diCards.ironWall.name: Iron Wall
diCards.ironWall.text: In Battle: your Troop gains +2 Defense
diCards.rainingFire.name: Raining Fire
diCards.rainingFire.text:
Remove 1 opponent Unit.
In Battle, during the Confirmation step: remove 1 opponent Unit from this Battle.
diCards.prayer.name: Prayer
diCards.prayer.text:
Gain 2☥.
In Battle: during the Confirmation step: gain 2☥.
diCards.enlistment.name: Enlistment
diCards.enlistment.text:
Add up to 2 Units spread between your Districts and/or your Troops.
In Battle, at the end of the Casualties step: Add up to 2 Units to your Troop.
diCards.manaDuplication.name: Mana Duplication
diCards.manaDuplication.text: In reaction to an opponent action: gain 1☥ + 1☥ per 2☥ they spent for this entire action.
diCards.transfer.name: Transfer
diCards.transfer.text: During your Movement action: teleport your Troop for free, wherever it stands, to a space containing an Obelisk.
diCards.openGates.name: Open Gates
diCards.openGates.text: During your Movement action: your Troop ignores the effects of 1 Wall.
diCards.veto.name: Veto
diCards.veto.text:
Cancel any effect of the DI card that have just been played.
A Veto card cannot be canceled by another Veto card.
diCards.escape.name: Escape
diCards.escape.text: When an opponent enters a space you control, no effect triggered by its entry is resolved and their Movement action ends immediately: no Battle Phase triggers, move your Troop to an adjacent empty space which is not an opponent District, this is not a Movement action.
powerTiles.diamond.priest.name: Priest
powerTiles.diamond.priestess.name: Priestess
powerTiles.diamond.priestess.text: During your Buy a Power tile actions: the cost of the Power you are buying is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0).
powerTiles.diamond.magicalSupport.name: Magical Support
powerTiles.diamond.magicalSupport.text: During your Raise a Pyramid actions: the cost of each level is reduced by 1☥ (to a minimum of 0).
powerTiles.diamond.highPriest.name: High Priest
powerTiles.diamond.highPriest.text: In Night Phase: during the Prayer step, gain 2☥.
powerTiles.diamond.divineHunger.name: Divine Hunger
powerTiles.diamond.divineHunger.text: In Battle: during the Casualties step, gain 2☥ per opponent Unit you removed with your Damage.
powerTiles.diamond.divineBoon.name: Divine Boon
powerTiles.diamond.divineBoon.text: In Night Phase: during the Divine intervention step, draw 1 DI card.
powerTiles.diamond.handOfGod.name: Hand of God
powerTiles.diamond.handOfGod.text: In Night Phase: during the Awakening step, you may raise one of your Pyramids 1 level for free.
powerTiles.diamond.vision.name: Vision
powerTiles.diamond.vision.text: In Night Phase: during the Divine intervention step, draw 4 extra DI cards you add to your hand, then discard 4 DI cards.
powerTiles.diamond.priestOfThoeris.name: Priest of Thoeris
powerTiles.diamond.priestOfThoeris.text: In Battle: during the Resolution step, gain 4☥ if you are the Champion (either as an attacker, or a defender).
powerTiles.diamond.domination.name: Domination
powerTiles.diamond.priestOfRa.name: Priest of Ra
powerTiles.diamond.priestOfRa.text: Each time you spend at least 1☥: this cost is reduced by 1☥ (to a minimum of 0).
powerTiles.diamond.priestOfAmon.name: Priest of Amon
powerTiles.diamond.priestOfAmon.text:
When you buy this tile: gain 5☥.
In Night Phase: during the Prayer step, gain 5☥.
powerTiles.diamond.theMummy.name: The Mummy
powerTiles.diamond.theMummy.text:
The tied Troop gains: +1 Land move, +2 Strength.
In Night Phase: during the Divine intervention step, draw 1DI card.
powerTiles.diamond.actOfGod.name: Act of God
powerTiles.ruby.charge.name: Charge!
powerTiles.ruby.charge.text: In Battle, when you are the attacker: your Troops gain +1 Strength.
powerTiles.ruby.stargate.name: Stargate
powerTiles.ruby.stargate.text: During your Movement actions: your Teleportation cost is reduced by 1☥ (to a minimum of 0).
powerTiles.ruby.priestOfMafdet.name: Priest of Mafdet
powerTiles.ruby.priestOfMafdet.text: During your Movement actions: your Troops gain +1 Land move.
powerTiles.ruby.carnage.name: Carnage
powerTiles.ruby.carnage.text: In Battle: your Troops gain +1 Damage.
powerTiles.ruby.wrrytStorm.name: Wrryt Storm
powerTiles.ruby.wrrytStorm.text: Take back all your Battle cards in hand, then remove from the game 1 of them and replace it with the special +3 Strength / 3 Damage Battle card. The removed card is kept secret.
powerTiles.ruby.sappers.name: Sappers
powerTiles.ruby.sappers.text: During your Movement actions: your Troops ignore the effects of 1 Wall.
powerTiles.ruby.portalOfThoth.name: Portal of Thoth
powerTiles.ruby.portalOfThoth.text: During your Movement actions: your Troops gain +1 Teleportation. Your Teleportations may be done from a space containing an Obelisk.
powerTiles.ruby.royalScarab.name: Royal Scarab
powerTiles.ruby.royalScarab.text: The tied Troop gains: +2 Land moves, +2 Strength.
powerTiles.ruby.bladesOfNeith.name: Blades of Neith
powerTiles.ruby.bladesOfNeith.text: In Battle: your Troops gain +1 Strength.
powerTiles.ruby.divineWound.name: Divine Wound
powerTiles.ruby.divineWound.text: In Battle: at the end of the Confrontation step, you may discard DI cards from your hand: for each card discarded this way, your Troop gains +1 Strength.
powerTiles.ruby.domination.name: Domination
powerTiles.ruby.giantScorpion.name: Giant Scorpion
powerTiles.ruby.giantScorpion.text: The tied Troop gains: +1 Land move, +2 Strength, +2 Damage.
powerTiles.ruby.initiative.name: Initiative
powerTiles.ruby.initiative.text: During your Movement actions, if your Troops enter a space containing an opponent Troop: remove 2 Units from the opponent Troop. If there is no opponent Troop left, the Battle does not trigger and you may continue your Movement action.
powerTiles.ruby.phoenix.name: Phoenix
powerTiles.ruby.phoenix.text: The tied Troop gains: +1 Land move, +2 Strength. During your Movement actions: the tied Troop ignores the effects of 1 Wall.
powerTiles.ruby.actOfGod.name: Act of God
powerTiles.sapphire.recruitingScribe.tex: During your Recruit actions: recruit up to 2 free Units.
powerTiles.sapphire.defense.name: Defense!
powerTiles.sapphire.defense.text: In Battle, when you are the defender: your Troops gain +1 Strength.
powerTiles.sapphire.legion.name: Legion
powerTiles.sapphire.ancestralElephant.te: The tied Troop gains: +1 Land move, +1 Strength, +1 Defense.
powerTiles.sapphire.shetywBarrier.name: Shetyw Barrier
powerTiles.sapphire.shetywBarrier.text: Take back all your Battle cards in hand, then remove from the game 1 of them and replace it with the special +3 Strength / 3 Defense Battle card. The removed card is kept secret.
powerTiles.sapphire.deepDesertSnake.name: Deep Desert Snake
powerTiles.sapphire.deepDesertSnake.text: The tied Troop gains: +1 Land move. In Battle: effects and bonuses of the opponent Creature are ignored.
powerTiles.sapphire.shieldsOfNeith.name: Shields of Neith
powerTiles.sapphire.shieldsOfNeith.text: In Battle: your Troops gain +1 Defense.
powerTiles.sapphire.defensiveVictory.tex: In Battle, when you are the defender: during the Reward step, if you are the Champion and your Troop still has at least 1 Unit, gain 1 Battle VP.
powerTiles.sapphire.prescience.name: Prescience
powerTiles.sapphire.prescience.text: In Battle: during the War Council step, your opponent reveals the Battle card they are playing before you choose your Battle cards.
powerTiles.sapphire.domination.name: Domination
powerTiles.sapphire.reinforcements.name: Reinforcements
powerTiles.sapphire.reinforcements.text: When you buy this tile: you may add up to 4 Units spread between your Districts and/or your Troops. In Night Phase: during the Awakening step, you may add up to 4 Units spread between your Districts and/or your Troops.
powerTiles.sapphire.sphinx.name: Sphinx
powerTiles.sapphire.sphinx.text: 1 Sphinx VP. The tied Troop gains: +2 Strength.
powerTiles.sapphire.divineWill.name: Divine Will
powerTiles.sapphire.divineWill.text: Take 1 gold Action token if you do not have any. Play your gold Action token on the icon on top of your pyramid: you may take either a Movement action, or a Recruit action.
powerTiles.sapphire.actOfGod.name: Act of God
powerTiles.onyxMercenaries.name: Mercenaries
powerTiles.onyxMercenaries.text: When you buy this tile: place the 3 Units from clan 1 in your City. They are considered as Units from your faction.
powerTiles.onyxLocalRecruitment.name: Local Recruitment
powerTiles.onyxLocalRecruitment.text: During your Recruit actions: you may spread the recruited Units between your Districts and/or your Troops.
powerTiles.onyxRiteOfAqen.name: Rite of Aqen
powerTiles.onyxRiteOfAqen.text: Take 1 gold Action token if you do not have any. Play your gold Action token on the icon on top of your pyramid: take a Pray action.
powerTiles.onyxHonorInBattle.name: Honor in Battle
powerTiles.onyxHonorInBattle.text: In Battle: at the end of the Casualties step, gain 1☥ for each of your Units removed by your opponent’s Damage.
powerTiles.onyxDedicationToBattle.name: Dedication to Battle
powerTiles.onyxDedicationToBattle.text: During your Movement actions, when your Troops enter a space controlled by an opponent Troop: gain 2☥ even if no Battle occurs.
powerTiles.onyxKhnumsSphinx.name: Khnum’s Sphinx
powerTiles.onyxKhnumsSphinx.text: The tied Troop gains: +1 Land move, +1 Strength. During opponents Movement actions, a Troop must spend 2 extra ☥ to enter the space controlled by Khnum’s Sphinx.
powerTiles.onyxTwinCeremony.name: Twin Ceremony
powerTiles.onyxTwinCeremony.text: Take 1 gold Action token if you do not have any. Play your gold Action token on the icon on top of your pyramid: take a Buy a Power tile action you have already played during this Round to buy a Power tile which cost is raised 1 extra ☥.
powerTiles.onyxGriffinSphinx.name: Griffin Sphinx
powerTiles.onyxGriffinSphinx.text: The tied Troop gains: +1 Teleportation, +2 Strength. Your Teleportations with the tied Troop may be done from a space containing an Obelisk.
powerTiles.onyxForcedMarch.name: Forced March
powerTiles.onyxForcedMarch.text: Take 1 gold Action token if you do not have any. Play your gold Action token on the icon on top of your pyramid: take a Movement action during which you cannot use any Teleportation.
powerTiles.onyxDeadlyTrap.name: Deadly Trap
powerTiles.onyxDeadlyTrap.text: During opponents Movement actions, when a Troop enters a space controlled by one of your Troops: remove 1 unit from this opponent Troop before resolving the Battle. If there’s no opponent Troop left, the Battle is not resolved.
powerTiles.onyxDomination.name: Domination
powerTiles.onyxAmmoutTheSoulDevourer.tex: The tied Troop gains: +1 Land move, +2 Strength. The tied Troop cancels any Damage it receives outside of any Battle. In Battle: during the Reward step, if you are the Champion and you have removed at least 2 Units from the opponent Troop with you Damage, gain 1 Battle VP.
powerTiles.onyxBestialFury.name: Bestial Fury
powerTiles.onyxBestialFury.text: During your Movement actions: your Troops gain +1 Land move. In Battle: your Troops gain +1 Strength and +1 Damage.
powerTiles.onyxDivineMight.name: Divine might
powerTiles.onyxDivineMight.text: In Day Phase: each time an effect other than this one makes you gain at least 1☥: gain 1 extra ☥.
powerTiles.onyxActOfGod.name: Act of God
powerTiles.onyxActOfGod.text: Take an additional silver Action Token. It must be placed and played at the same time as a regular token.
